extracted.name: 1minute Nutochoco mug cake in microwave
extracted.description: Instant mug cake recipe for kids
instruction_lines: In a mug mix all the dry ingredients then mix wet ingredients
Then add the nutella on top of the batter
Bake it in microwave for 1minute after that topping with some nutella and chocos also sprinkle some sugar
